title: 国新办推进医保高质量发展、更好服务中国式现代化建设有关情况新闻发布会 (State Council Information Office press conference on high-quality development of medical security, transcript)
date_evidence: meta-PubDate: 2026-09-04 12:04; 日期：2026-09-04; 国务院新闻办公室于2026年9月4日（星期五）上午10时举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会
key_claim: NHSA deputy head Li Tao said the basic-insurance drug list has added 949 drugs including 199 innovative drugs since 2018, and that for innovative drugs beyond the basic-insurance scope the agency will refine the commercial-insurance innovative drug list and recommend that commercial health insurance pays first; the briefing also confirmed a first-launch-price self-assessment regime for new drugs, case-by-case DRG exemptions (特例单议), and the Medical Security Law signed on 28 August 2026 taking effect on 1 January 2027.
frame_summary: The NHSA argues that basic insurance must stay within its 'cover the basics' remit while high-cost innovation is routed through a commercial-insurance-first layer, framed as 'dual protection' and now underpinned by a statute that names commercial health insurance as part of the multi-tier system.
verbatim_quote: 同时，我们也将优化完善商业健康保险创新药品目录，对超出基本医保范围但是创新程度高、临床价值大、患者获益明显的创新药，推荐商业健康险先行支付。通过“基本医保+商业健康险”双重保障，减轻重病患者的家庭经济负担。
verbatim_list: 2018年以来，我们持续健全医保药品目录动态调整机制，累计新增纳入949种药，其中含199种创新药，让更多的患者用得上也用得起更多救急救命的好药。
一是实行新上市药品首发价格企业自评制度，根据企业自评结果分别予以政策支持和引导，支持高水平创新药在上市初期制定与高投入、高风险相符的价格，并且在一定时期内保持价格的相对稳定。
8月28日，国家主席习近平签署第80号主席令，公布《中华人民共和国医疗保障法》，将从2027年1月1日起施行。
另一方面，落实医疗机构特例单议工作机制，针对住院时间长、病情复杂、使用新药新耗材新技术等不适合按病种付费的一些病例，医疗机构可以按程序申报，专家评审后调整支付标准或者按项目付费

title: Early learnings from China's new Commercial Health Insurance Innovative Drug Catalogue
date_evidence: By Faith Wong, Rui Fung, Carol Kao, Smarth Lakhanpal | March 18, 2026
key_claim: Of 121 therapies that passed preliminary review for the first catalogue, 42 (34.7%) filed CHI-only and 19 (13.5%) were listed; the catalogue is not legally binding on insurers, expected price cuts are about 20-40% against 50-70% for NRDL listing, and early evidence suggests it may consolidate existing commercial coverage rather than expand access.
frame_summary: Avalere argues the first catalogue is a payer endorsement of high-cost breakthrough therapies that manufacturers still treat as complementary to the NRDL, and that without a binding roadmap for insurers it may consolidate coverage that already existed rather than widen it.
verbatim_quote: Of the 121 therapies that passed preliminary review, 42 (34.7%) pursued CHI-only submissions (predominantly in oncology and rare diseases), while the remainder submitted in parallel to both the NRDL and CHI.
verbatim_list: However, the final inclusion of only 19 therapies (13.5% success rate), together with the exceptional clinical profiles of listed drugs, indicates that the inaugural CHI Catalogue applied stringent evidentiary criteria.

While the CHI Catalogue is not legally binding for insurers, these features result in manageable and predictable payouts, supporting sustainable risk pooling and encouraging voluntary adoption by commercial insurers.
Current evidence suggests that the CHI Catalogue may initially consolidate existing commercial coverage rather than immediately expanding access to treatments.

In addition, price reductions under CHI negotiations are expected to be more moderate than under NRDL negotiations, with experts estimating reductions of approximately 20–40% compared with 50–70% typically observed for NRDL-listed therapies.
notes: Structural anchor in the 3-6 month band: the canonical English-language Tier 2 analysis of the first catalogue's funnel and its non-binding status. title: China insurance in 2026: resilience amid structural divergence (World Insurance sigma 2/2026, regional perspective)
date_evidence: PDF title page: '©2026 Swiss Re. All rights reserved. July 2026 Sigma insights'; file stamp in the publication URL: 2026-07-sri-world-insurance-sigma-china-en.2026-07-20-13-06-23.pdf
key_claim: Chinese health insurance premiums grew 6.0% in 2025 and are expected to grow 6.5-7.5% in 2026, while growth in protection products is expected to remain subdued as households favour savings products.
frame_summary: Swiss Re argues that China's insurance growth is moderating and diverging by line, with health premiums growing steadily on supplementary-protection demand but protection products subdued and savings products outgrowing them.
verbatim_quote: Health insurance has remained one of the fastest-growing segments of China's non-life market, growth of 6.0% in 2025, supported by strong demand for supplementary health protection and the continued expansion of digital distribution and healthcare ecosystems. We expect growth to slightly rise to 6.5% -7.5% in 2026.
verbatim_list: By contrast, growth in protection products is expected to remain relatively subdued in the near term, reflecting soft consumer confidence and cautious income expectations.

title: 2026年商保创新药目录申报药品数量同比减少过半 目录落地难题待解 (Applications to the 2026 commercial-insurance innovative drug list fall by more than half; implementation problems unresolved)
date_evidence: meta-article:published_time: 2026-06-16T19:53:48+08:00; 2026年06月16日 19:47 每日经济新闻
key_claim: Filings for the 2026 commercial list totalled 61 (17 CHI-only and 44 dual) against 141 in 2025, a fall of more than half; Shanghai's Huhuibao removed Yescarta and Fabrazyme from cover; hospitals show 'a list but no prescriptions'; and the 2026 cycle lets listed drugs apply directly to the basic list, a 'commercial insurance explores, basic insurance takes over' model.
frame_summary: National Business Daily argues the first list underperformed expectations and halved manufacturers' appetite because payment, hospital access and risk-sharing mechanisms are missing, and that the new bridge to the NRDL repositions the commercial list as an early-stage staging post rather than a standalone market.
verbatim_quote: 从申报情况来看，本次单独申报商保创新药目录的药品共17份，同时申报基本目录和商保目录的有44份，合计61份，较2025年141份的申报量降幅过半。
verbatim_list: 近期，惠民保头部标杆“沪惠保”将商保创新药品目录中的部分药品调出，已被国家医疗保障行政部门正式发文纳入国家基本医疗保险、工伤保险和生育保险药品目录的药品及阿加糖酶β（法布赞）、阿基仑赛注射液（奕凯达）不再纳入“沪惠保”保障。

医生因担心触碰违规红线，对开具高价值创新药普遍持观望态度，导致“有目录、无处方”。

title: 商保创新药目录落地进程追踪：如何打通“最后一公里”？ (Tracking implementation of the commercial-insurance innovative drug list: how to clear the last mile)
date_evidence: meta-article:published_time: 2026-07-04T02:50:39+08:00; 2026年07月04日 02:36 中国经营报
key_claim: Huiminbao schemes paid 18亿 yuan for innovative drugs in 2025, flat on the year, while individual medical policies raised payments 40%; by 20 January 2026 listed drugs were stocked in 223 institutions, 12.3% of tertiary hospitals and under 1% of primary facilities; one city scheme that had paid over 4000万 yuan on 80-plus lymphoma claims dropped Yescarta from 2026 cover; the insurance association's catalogue is being built on risk-sharing with a claims cap above which the drugmaker pays.
frame_summary: China Business Journal argues the list is still a 'policy list' rather than an 'effective payment mechanism': Huiminbao cannot carry high-cost claims, hospitals ration through hidden controls, insurers bear all the risk, and the industry's answer is to push claims above a cap back onto manufacturers.
verbatim_quote: 根据中再寿险、镁信健康发布的《2026中国创新药械多元支付白皮书》，2025年惠民保对创新药支付贡献值为18亿元，与上一年持平，当年惠民保特药理赔速度放缓；而个人医疗险（百万险/中高端险/带病体医疗险）对创新药支付较上一年显著增长40%。
verbatim_list: 近日，创新药与商业健康险协同发展学术交流会上披露的数据显示，从商保药品入院情况看，截至2026年1月20日，商保目录药品配备机构数量223家，三级医院覆盖率为12.3%，基层医疗机构覆盖率极低，低于1%。
过去3年已有80多例淋巴瘤患者获得奕凯达治疗理赔，累计赔付金额超过4000万元。不过，据上述人士透露，近期开放参保的该地2026年惠民保中，该款特药已被移出特药保障目录。
据记者向多位业内人士了解，保险行业协会牵头建设的目录采取风险共担的形式——与药企设定赔付上限，超出上限的部分，由药企承担，以降低保司风险。
数据分析表明，169款基础版传统惠民保中，有16款目录药品已实现覆盖，但是产品落地差异显著。

title: China Pharma Trends: Premium Pricing and Priority Access for True Innovations
date_evidence: Commentary|Articles|June 11, 2026 Pharmaceutical Executive: June 2026 Volume 46 Issue 5
key_claim: The State Council's spring 2026 drug-pricing guidance supports premium launch pricing and priority access for true innovations and calls for faster C-List implementation; the first C-List of 19 drugs offers a route without NRDL price ceilings and cuts, but uptake to date has varied widely across products and regions.
frame_summary: A Simon-Kucher partner argues the State Council guidance is an encouraging signal for premium launch pricing sustained by real-world evidence, and that the C-List is a promising NRDL-free channel whose uneven uptake is a detail to be fixed rather than a flaw in the design.
verbatim_quote: In this regard, C-List does open up a new possibility without the price ceiling constraints and price-cut concessions typical of NRDL listing, while the actual uptake to date has seen large variance across different products and regions. In light of this, the State Council guidance calls for more concerted efforts to accelerate C-List landing.
verbatim_list: The new policy makes a clear distinction between innovative drugs and others and supports premium pricing and priority access for true innovations. It further states that price premiums could be maintained and even adjusted upward as appropriate if supported by robust RWE and clinical outcomes.

The first C-List features 19 innovative drugs, including some high-value oncology therapies such as CAR-Ts and T-cell engagers, with annual treatment costs over $200,000, as well as rare disease drugs such as enzyme-replacement therapies for Gaucher disease, costing up to $300,000.
